name: Sentinel
tagline: A VS Code extension that catches embedded-hardware bugs such as wrong pins or memory overflow as you type.
problem: In embedded development, errors like invalid pins, bad I2C addresses or RAM overflow show up only after flashing the board.
solution: A hardware-aware language-server extension that checks firmware against the target board's constraints in real time, moving error detection from after compilation to while typing.
demo_moment: Team-described: type a misconfigured pin and see the warning before compiling.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Developer Tool by Warp” among 82 submissions.
Brings type-checking-style feedback to a field still debugging by trial and error.

lessons: A developer-tool prize favours a precise fix for a pain the judges know.
